metadata.title: Ricci curvature of semigroup walks on graphs and generator representations
metadata.abstract: We present an operator-theoretic framework for the Ollivier--Ricci curvature of (one-parameter families of) random walks generated by positive semigroups on graphs. On a metrically complete graph $(G,d)$ that is $d$-locally finite, we introduce a class of admissible semigroup random walks whose infinitesimal first-order approximation is itself a random walk. We prove that the Ollivier--Ricci curvature of an admissible semigroup random walk is well-defined and completely determined by its first-order approximation. We then establish a variational representation of the curvature of random walks in terms of a notion of the initial-time generator. This representation applies in particular to admissible semigroup random walks. Finally, we use this representation to define an operator-theoretic Ollivier--Ricci curvature for operators acting on spaces of functions over general metric spaces and establish sufficient conditions for well-definedness. This framework contains, in particular, Markovian random walks associated with discrete Laplacians.
metadata.comment: 20 pages. Comments and suggestions are welcomed

analysis.progressType: 图随机游走曲率的生成元表示
analysis.workSummary: 在度量完备且 d-局部有限的图上，引入一阶无穷小近似本身仍为随机游走的 admissible 半群游走，证明其 Ollivier–Ricci 曲率良定义且完全由一阶近似确定。进一步给随机游走曲率的初始时刻生成元变分表达，并推广到一般度量空间函数算子的曲率定义及良定义充分条件。
techniques: 正算子半群与一阶随机游走近似
analysis.breakthrough: 将离散 Laplacian/Markov 游走曲率放入统一算子理论框架。
analysis.limitations: 不是任意正半群自动满足 admissible 条件；图的完备与局部有限条件及一般算子曲率良定义条件须保留，推广不是所有算子的无条件定义。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 离散曲率与半群分析有关，属于比较几何交叉方向的相关工具。
